svg.title: Mistral API source confusion matrix — row percentages
svg.desc: Rows are true sources; columns are predicted sources. Values are row percentages; each true-source row sums to 100% before rounding.
svg.text: Mistral API source confusion matrix — row percentages
Rows: true source · Columns: predicted source · n: true records
Columns: Chk=chicken · Env=environment · Lab=laboratory · Other=other_animal · Food=other_food · Turk=turkey · Unk=unknown · WW=wastewater · Wildbird=wildbird
Values are row percentages; each true-source row sums to 100% before rounding.
